appended_meaning:
The health-transfer financing context is separately bound at the exact current source and voted EH extent. Complete 3014(h)(1) requires a transfer from amounts appropriated under PPACA 10503(b)(1), classified to 42 USC 254b-2(b)(1), for FY2015 and each subsequent fiscal year or period thereof. The annual amount equals the amount transferred under assessment subsection (d), subject to a $5 million annual floor and $30 million annual ceiling, and remains available until expended. These are bounds in each fiscal year, not a new floor or ceiling for every partial-year health extension, not the entire CHC appropriation, not the assessment charged to each offender and not an observed transfer, award or service. The existing complete assessment/fund boundaries remain distinct.

The selected complete CHC source retains its authorized-and-appropriated Treasury funding introduction, HHS purpose and transfer to enhanced community-health-center funding under 254b. The selected (b)(1) source is distinct from the separately printed National Health Service Corps (b)(2) and construction funding; those other appropriations are not treated as the 3014(h)(1) source. The availability provision keeps (b)/(c) amounts available until expended; codification identifies PPACA, rather than enacting this section as part of the Public Health Service Act. The complete source preserves every dated (b)(1) clause, including the printed overlapping 2023/2024 periods and its 'So in original' footnote. Those periods are not silently repaired or summed into a new amount.

Original PL118-158 section 3101(a) separates the old combined (F) funding text into dated (G)-(I) clauses, including $1,050,410,959 for January 1-March 31, 2025. Complete 3101(e)(1) replaces the former (E)/(F)-only source reference with the whole 10503(b)(1) source for FY2015 and each subsequent fiscal year or period thereof. That enacted source-reference change is already reflected in the current 3014(h)(1) witness; it does not remove the annual $5-30 million bounds or appropriate the whole CHC amount to victim services.

Exact voted EH 2101(a) adds $2,135,835,616 for April 1-September 30, 2025 to the CHC source as new clause (J). The literal duplicate 'inserting and inserting' and trailing '; and' remain in the source; no glyph or operative-text repair is made. This dated CHC appropriation amendment is distinct from a $2,135,835,616 victim-services grant, a new transfer floor or an actual amount delivered. The separately printed NHSC and teaching-health-center amendments are outside this selected financing-source review.

Complete current 3014(h)(4) retains its eleven printed continuing-conditions authorities. Actual original 3101(d) requires amounts appropriated by its section's amendments to be subject to PL117-328 requirements for funds for programs under PHSA sections 330-340; original 3101(e)(2) adds that actual 3101(d) identity to (h)(4) and identifies the earlier 101(d) as division G of PL118-42. Exact EH 2101(d) repeats the PL117-328/PHSA330-340 requirements reference for its section's amendment appropriations; 2101(e) adds the exact division B 2101(d) identity to the continuing (h)(4) list. These are source-grounded conditions-reference mechanisms. They do not establish the content, extent or application of every incorporated condition, unrestricted medical spending, repeal of conditions or a particular individual's coverage.

The Code references-in-text note describes the 3101(d) authority as section 101(d) of PL118-158, while its operative (h)(4), the complete original 3101(d) and original conforming amendment consistently identify 3101(d). Both the editorial mismatch and actual operative witnesses are preserved. The candidate follows the actual operative authority for this literal reference identity without silently editing the source, substituting a different section or adjudicating full legal application.

This bounded increment completes the annual transfer financing/source and exact 2101(a)/(d)/(e) reference mechanisms, not full fund-health review. Complete medical-grant and conditional child-service rules in (h)(2)-(3), the eleven incorporated conditions Acts and material PL117-328 program/general conditions remain executable research. Duplicate subsection-(f) application Q68 remains specifically about fund (e); that reserved question is not expanded or treated as resolution of (h)(2)'s reference. All 69 prior application questions remain unchanged. State/migration/refugee assistance, supplementary/other DHS, exact counterparts, whole-package comparison and ordinary screenings continue. No actual award, individual eligibility, whole-fund/package/domain closure or editorial acceptance is declared.

(a) Purpose It is the purpose of this section to establish a Community Health Center Fund (referred to in this section as the "CHC Fund"), to be administered through the Office of the Secretary of the Department of Health and Human Services to provide for expanded and sustained national investment in community health centers under section 254b of this title and the National Health Service Corps.
